module_summary: 8-to-16-bit width converter: a toggle flag alternates between buffering the first valid byte and concatenating it with the second into a registered 16-bit word with valid pulse.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Two-phase toggle selecting buffer-first-byte vs emit-word on each valid input.

anchors.name: data_lock
anchors.why: Holds first byte until second arrives; forms upper half of data_out.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input byte valid; toggles flag and enables capture/output.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 8-bit input byte stored or concatenated into output.

groups.name: phase_control
groups.description: Toggle flag sequencing byte capture and output valid.

groups.name: width_packer
groups.description: Byte buffer and concatenation into 16-bit output register.
